label: lte-rf-narrow-20261019-05
method: Selected 3 ms burst windows: maximum spectrum per 20 kHz bin minus median spectrum during sample-relative seconds 105–130, clipped at zero; weighted center and central 90% excess-power interval. Relative power only.
grant_method: Generated RAR bytes decoded using current ground fill_rar_br packing for 50 PRB / 3 narrowband-index bits; MAC source assigns first 2 PRBs of NB2. This does not prove UE reception or decoding of the RAR.
interpretation: Observed burst spectra are consistent with the generated two-PRB Msg3 grant. No LTE waveform was decoded, transmitter identity is unproven, and subframe timing has not been aligned.
